about: What computer.app does through the vscode bridge word, for the writer of program instructions (Lane VS1, Orbit's VS Code extension). The bridge sheet's own shape (Lane G's bridge-facts.json), for the bridge word Orbit gives VS Code, Antigravity IDE and VSCodium on Linux (desktop/oshal-node/src/main/linux-program-versions.ts VSCODE_BRIDGE). Written from Orbit's code at the kernel commit named and the real-VS Code suite desktop/oshal-node/scripts/test-vscode-extension-desktop.cjs; every verb id names the source line it is read from, and tests/sheet/vscode-sources.test.cjs fails when Orbit's code declares other verbs. press and select are not listed: the extension's elements are the file and the selection, which take type. As built at that commit; no planned change is described.
generator: program-instructions/inputs/vscode-bridge-facts.json, written from Orbit's code and the real-VS Code suite

vscode.programs: A bound VS Code (or Antigravity IDE, VSCodium) window whose Orbit extension is connected to Orbit's plugin door (desktop/oshal-node/src/main/bridges/vscode.ts, the extension in desktop/oshal-node/plugins/vscode). Without the extension the window reads as the accessibility bridge reads it and declares nothing.
